newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank of China HK branch doubles FRCD to HK$4 bln.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China HK branch doubles FRCD to HK$4 bln.

text.p: Bank of China Hong Kong branch has increased its floating rate certificate of deposit issue to HK$4.0 billion owing to strong demand in syndication, arranger China Development Finance Co (CDFC) said Wednesday.
The issue was was hugely oversubscribed to HK$9.0 billion, 4.5 times the HK$2.0 billion sought at the deal's launch in September.
But Bank of China Hong Kong branch has opted to borrow only HK$4.0 billion, so allocations will be scaled back, CDFC said.
CDFC said 61 banks participated in the transaction.
Final allotments are expected to be released later today or on Thursday.
The five-year certificates pay a margin of 35 basis points over the one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate and, with fees, an all-in return of 41.5 basis points to top-tier participants.
